text:
sofia: Heads up — seeing multiple orgs with $0 or NaN on the Token Cost dashboard since ~08:10 UTC. Customer ticket #7892 reporting screenshots and confused billing ops. dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/9982/costs :alarm_clock:

jamie: I can repro for a couple of orgs. Running the aggregation query returns NULL for token_cost_usd in the rolled-up table for orgs 4241 and 9982. Front-end treats that as NaN for per-token math, and $0 for simple sum display. Example query I ran:
```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(token_cost_usd) AS total_cost
FROM metrics.daily_token_costs
WHERE day >= '2026-03-16' AND org_id IN (4241, 9982)
GROUP BY org_id;
```
Result includes total_cost = NULL for org 9982.

liam: Looks like the new aggregator SQL dropped a COALESCE on token_price. I saw a deploy this morning. Repro locally: coalesce(sum(token_price * token_count), 0) resolves to 0 instead of NULL. Without coalesce it stays NULL which the UI later shows as NaN in per-request charts.

sofia: Customer says some rows are $0 (they think it's free) and some are NaN (broken chart). Org example: 9982 — token_count nonzero but token_price NULL for ~422 events between 07:58–08:05 UTC.

jamie: Pipeline logs show a spike of metric_value: NaN at 08:09 on agg-node-a. analytics-bot posted a deploy earlier: 2026.03.16-agg-v2 (commit d4f7c3b). Could be the culprit.

analytics-bot: Deploy 2026.03.16-agg-v2 succeeded at 07:58 UTC on agg-node-a.

paul: Checking infra — node disk is fine. I can confirm agg-v2 rolled with the new SQL around 07:57. Rolling the aggregator back to 2026.03.15-agg-v1 on a dev cluster restores non-NULL sums in my local repro.

sofia: Support repro steps to give customer (short):
1) API: GET /orgs/9982/metrics?range=day&metric=token_cost returns {"value": 0} or {"value": "NaN"} depending on chart.
2) DB: run the SQL above and inspect token_price IS NULL rows (example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE org_id=9982 AND token_price IS NULL AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-16T07:55Z' AND '2026-03-16T08:10Z').
3) Mitigation: temporarily patch aggregation to COALESCE(token_price, 0) or roll back to agg-v1.

jamie: I'll open a PR with the minimal COALESCE hotfix and request a canary deploy onto non-prod first. If that looks good we can promote. Need approval from infra for prod rollout.

liam: Agreed. Severity: P2 (dashboard-only, not billing charges). Still customer-facing so we should aim for a 2-hour mitigation ETA. Also add a SQL schema guard in migrations to prevent NULL token_price ingestion going forward.

maya: Support lead here — I've notified the customer and added mitigation steps + the current ETA (2 hours). I'll update ticket #7892 with repro steps and the rollback plan. Please ping when hotfix is up so I can confirm on their side. :thumbsup:

paul: I'll prepare runbook for rollback and approve canary if analytics tests pass. Log note: affected orgs seen in the page of the dashboard: 4241, 9982, 2177.

sofia: Thanks everyone — tagging @support and @eng-analytics channels for visibility. Will follow up when PR/rollback is complete.
